webhooks.detail: Pumble apps (Node SDK) subscribe to events via in-app listeners: NEW_MESSAGE, UPDATED_MESSAGE, REACTION_ADDED, CHANNEL_CREATED/ARCHIVED/DELETED, WORKSPACE_USER_JOINED/UPDATED, user group events. Scope-gated. No generic webhook-URL subscription API found; incoming webhooks exist for posting messages only.

evidence.quote: To subscribe to events, you have to add the event listeners in the main `App`. Events do not need to be acknowledged.

sandbox.detail: No dedicated sandbox or dev-workspace doc found. API-key add-on is stated as available on all plans, so a free workspace likely works for testing, but this was not confirmed on the vendor pages checked.

rate_limits.summary: 3,000 req/min per app; 1,000 req/min per user; lower per-endpoint caps (e.g. send message 80/min per app+workspace); 429 with Retry-After

evidence.quote: Total App Requests: 3.000 total requests per minute window across your entire app.
